title: Register Kardialer Computertomographie
summary: The aim of this Heidelberg Cardiac CT Registry (Register kardiale Computertomographie) is to assess the diagnostic and prognostic perfomance of cardiac CT exminations in a real-world patient population.
conditions: Evaluation of CT in Coronary Artery Stenosis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• Subjects referred for cardiac CT examination by their physician

Exclusion Criteria:

• none
